testcase.name: at ROTATION_90 the Map tab's rail overlays the map on the right, the port edge, and the map is full-bleed
at ROTATION_90 no control on the map sits under the rail
a long-press on the translucent rail's own area selects the rail item, not the map
in fullscreen the rail is absent and a long-press at the map's port-side edge reaches the map
at ROTATION_90 long-presses beside the rail, along its inner edge, reach the map
the map's measured bounds are identical with the rail shown and hidden
a short landscape window gets the compact tree, not the permanent drawer
at ROTATION_270 long-presses beside the rail, along its inner edge, reach the map
on another tab the rail is opaque beside the content, and a real touch on a rail item switches the tab
at ROTATION_270 the Map tab's rail overlays the map on the left, the port edge, and the map is full-bleed
at ROTATION_270 no control on the map sits under the rail
